captured_note: Ported from the capture's self-contained methods/28_dinov2, specifically its Step-1 'As-is comparison' (evaluate_linear.py, configs/step1_model.yaml). The capture's default step 1 (use_pretrained: true, train_path: null) downloads the official pretrained DINOv2 backbone via torch.hub and linear-probes it, because the from-scratch pretraining data (LVD-142M) is not public. That from-scratch SSL path (use_pretrained: false) is now ported additively as the unified Step 2 (a ViT-B/16 trained from scratch on ImageNet-1k, DINO + iBOT + KoLeo -- see the Step 2 files below), the DINOv2 sibling of 36_franca; the downloaded Step-1 probe is unchanged. The port keeps the capture directory numbering (28) per the 2026-08-09 keep-capture-numbering decision (this list's number 30 is DINOv2 -- see docs/PORTING_ROADMAP.md).

paper.title: DINOv2: Learning Robust Visual Features without Supervision
paper.authors: Oquab, Darcet, Moutakanni, Vo, Szafraniec, Khalidov, Fernandez, Haziza, Massa, El-Nouby, et al.

upstream.note: Pinned DIRECTLY (no fork): the frozen backbone forward has no hardcoded device, and the xformers path is disabled at eval so the forward is torch-only. Imported through PYTHONPATH under third_party/dinov2, never copied or installed.

scope: Two comparisons are ported. Step 1 (as-is): freeze the official pretrained DINOv2 ViT-g/14 (LVD-142M) backbone (pinned third_party/dinov2, xformers disabled so the forward is torch-only) and fit a linear probe on its frozen CLS token; the from-scratch data (LVD-142M) is not public, so the as-is row reuses the official backbone. Step 2 (unified): train a ViT-B/16 FROM SCRATCH on ImageNet-1k with the DINOv2 objective (DINO + iBOT + KoLeo) and linear-probe the trained encoder -- this is the capture's step 2, ported additively (recipe: unified on the eval) so DINOv2 sits on the same unified axis as every other method; it removes the data confound (ImageNet-1k for all).
encoder: encoder.pt is written only by the Step-2 pretrain: the EMA teacher backbone (teacher_bb.*, the prefix stripped so it loads into a plain DINOv2Backbone), with the DINO/iBOT heads, the student and the centering buffers dropped, plus encoder_epoch{100,200,300}.pt per milestone. The Step-1 as-is comparison writes no encoder.pt -- it probes the official pretrained DINOv2 backbone, fetched as a hash-pinned download (backbone_artifact below), not produced here.
linear_eval: Probes DINOv2's pretrained ViT-g/14 CLS token (forward_features(x)['x_norm_clstoken']), frozen. This is a genuine SSL representation, so the number is comparable (the capture's 'As-is comparison / pretrained-backbone reuse' row, like 36_franca). A real run needs the official checkpoint (backbone_artifact below, fetched and hash-verified by bin/fetch-weights.py --artifact backbone_artifact, passed as the config's train.ckpt); the hermetic smoke leaves ckpt empty and builds a random ViT-S/14 (pretrained=False) at a tiny resolution, so nothing is downloaded and only the pipeline is exercised. Images use resize + centre crop + ImageNet normalisation; the probe follows the lab's shared ARSSL protocol (mean-centre + L2-normalise features, single linear layer, SGD momentum + cosine, top1/top5). See docs/EVAL_DOWNLOAD.md.

backbone_artifact.name: DINOv2 ViT-g/14 LVD-142M pretrain backbone
backbone_artifact.sha256_source: measured on 2026-08-10 by a full download from dl.fbaipublicfiles.com; bin/fetch-weights.py re-verifies this value on download

rewritten_during_the_port: Step 1 (as-is) freezes the official pretrained backbone; Step 2 (unified) is now ported additively: a from-scratch ViT-B/16 pretraining + a linear_eval that probes the trained encoder (recipe: unified). The eval-only Step-1 path is unchanged.

the backbone is the pinned upstream (third_party/dinov2), imported not copied; the capture called torch.hub.load, which fetches code at runtime -- this port pins the code (submodule) and the weights (hash-pinned download) instead

the xformers path is disabled (XFORMERS_DISABLED=1) before the backbone is imported, so the attention and the giant's SwiGLU use torch fallbacks -- reproducible on a CPU or any GPU; the weights still load strict
the device is resolved (resolve_device) instead of assumed CUDA
features are extracted in fp32 (the capture used a bfloat16 autocast, a GPU speed path with no meaningful effect on a frozen-feature linear probe)

the probe follows the lab's shared ARSSL protocol (mean-centre + L2-normalise, single linear layer, SGD + cosine) rather than the capture's own AdamW head, so the number is comparable across the ported methods

the unified Step-2 model/loss/data are ported from the capture's own methods/28_dinov2/{models,data} (DINOv2Backbone on a timm ViT with an iBOT mask token; DINOLoss/iBOTLoss/KoLeoLoss; multi-crop + batch-time iBOT block masking). build_dinov2_model threads the ViT dims into timm.create_model (the capture built the fixed vit_base_patch16_224) so a hermetic CPU smoke can run a tiny ViT. timm is therefore a Step-2 dependency, added to the lock at the fleet version (timm==1.0.28); it is built from scratch (no download), so CI stays hermetic.

train_pretrain_vit_dinov2.py is a single-process port of the capture's train_step2_vit.py: the per-epoch warmup->cosine LR (peak = base_lr x batch/1024), the per-step teacher-momentum cosine, the teacher-temp warmup, the shared DINO/iBOT head, freeze_last_layer for the first epoch and gradient-norm clipping are kept; DDP, TensorBoard and the distributed collapse/health gate are dropped for a single-process fp32 run; the device is resolved instead of assumed CUDA. Milestone checkpoint_epoch_{N}.pth is written at each training.save_at_epochs.

the adapter gained a pretrain stage (nested config, validated block by block) and a Step-2 linear_eval (recipe: unified) that probes the trained teacher encoder.pt (ENCODER_PREFIX teacher_bb.) at its CLS token; evaluate_linear_dinov2.extract_cls takes the CLS via the backbone's get_cls_token for Step 2 and the official dict feature_key for Step 1. configs/pretrain_vit.yaml and configs/linear_eval_vit.yaml are added.
